verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy is a fair privacy-posture question for an identity and access management product, since such products handle sensitive user data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI model training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The account console, terms-and-conditions and user-attribute features are adjacent and do not address training-data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
